records.name: Production Summary
records.query:
select
 pm.colour as "Colour::90",
 pm.size as "Size::60",
 ifnull(max(l.order_qty), 0) as "Order Qty:Int:80",
 ifnull(max(l.planned_cut_qty), 0) as "Planned Cut:Int:90",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'CUT' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Cut:Int:70",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'CUT_REJECT' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Cut Reject:Int:85",
 (sum(case when pm.stage = 'CUT' then pm.qty else 0 end) - sum(case when pm.stage = 'CUT_REJECT' then pm.qty else 0 end)) as "Good Cut:Int:80",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'SEW_IN' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Sewing In:Int:80",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'SEW_OUT' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Sewn Out:Int:80",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'SEW_REJECT' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Sewing Reject:Int:95",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'SC_OUT' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Sent Out:Int:75",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'SC_BACK_GOOD' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Back Good:Int:80",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'SC_BACK_REJECT_VENDOR' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Back Reject Vendor:Int:120",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'SC_BACK_REJECT_FACTORY' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Back Reject Factory:Int:125",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'FIN_IN' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Finishing In:Int:95",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'FIN_A' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "A-grade:Int:75",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'FIN_B' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "B-grade:Int:75",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'FIN_REJECT' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Finishing Reject:Int:110",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'SAMPLE_OUT' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Samples:Int:75",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'PACKED' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Packed:Int:70",
 sum(case when pm.stage = 'SHIPPED' then pm.qty else 0 end) as "Shipped:Int:75",
 (sum(case when pm.stage = 'FIN_A' then pm.qty else 0 end) - sum(case when pm.stage = 'SAMPLE_OUT' then pm.qty else 0 end) - sum(case when pm.stage = 'PACKED' then pm.qty else 0 end)) as "A-grade Not Packed:Int:125",
 (sum(case when pm.stage = 'PACKED' then pm.qty else 0 end) - sum(case when pm.stage = 'SHIPPED' then pm.qty else 0 end)) as "Packed Not Shipped:Int:125",
 (sum(case when pm.stage = 'CUT_REJECT' then pm.qty else 0 end) + sum(case when pm.stage = 'SEW_REJECT' then pm.qty else 0 end) + sum(case when pm.stage = 'SC_BACK_REJECT_VENDOR' then pm.qty else 0 end) + sum(case when pm.stage = 'SC_BACK_REJECT_FACTORY' then pm.qty else 0 end) + sum(case when pm.stage = 'FIN_REJECT' then pm.qty else 0 end)) as "All Rejects:Int:90",
 round(100 * (sum(case when pm.stage = 'CUT_REJECT' then pm.qty else 0 end) + sum(case when pm.stage = 'SEW_REJECT' then pm.qty else 0 end) + sum(case when pm.stage = 'SC_BACK_REJECT_VENDOR' then pm.qty else 0 end) + sum(case when pm.stage = 'SC_BACK_REJECT_FACTORY' then pm.qty else 0 end) + sum(case when pm.stage = 'FIN_REJECT' then pm.qty else 0 end)) / nullif(sum(case when pm.stage = 'CUT' then pm.qty else 0 end) - sum(case when pm.stage = 'CUT_REJECT' then pm.qty else 0 end), 0), 2) as "Rejection %%:Percent:90",
 round(100 * sum(case when pm.stage = 'SHIPPED' then pm.qty else 0 end) / nullif(sum(case when pm.stage = 'CUT' then pm.qty else 0 end), 0), 2) as "Cut to Ship %%:Percent:95",
 round(100 * sum(case when pm.stage = 'SHIPPED' then pm.qty else 0 end) / nullif(ifnull(max(l.order_qty), 0), 0), 2) as "Order to Ship %%:Percent:100"
from `tabProduction Movement` pm
left join `tabProduction Card Line` l on l.parent = pm.production_card and l.colour = pm.colour and l.size = pm.size
where pm.production_card = %(production_card)s and pm.purpose in ('Bulk', 'Re-cut')
group by pm.colour, pm.size
order by pm.colour, pm.size

records.query: select count(*) as "Lines:Int:80" from `tabFabric Requisition Item` c join `tabFabric Requisition` p on p.name = c.parent where p.docstatus = 1 and p.status not in ('Superseded', 'Cancelled') and c.net_qty > 0 and c.required_by < curdate() and c.accepted_qty < c.net_qty

records.name: Trim Lines On Hold Count
records.query: select count(*) as "Lines:Int:80" from `tabTrim Requisition Item` c join `tabTrim Requisition` p on p.name = c.parent where p.docstatus = 1 and p.status not in ('Superseded', 'Cancelled') and c.hold = 1 and c.ordered_qty = 0
